verdicts.title: Twisted Graph States for Ancilla-driven Universal Quantum Computation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce a new paradigm for quantum computing called Ancilla-Driven Quantum Computation (ADQC) which combines aspects both of the quantum circuit [D. Deutsch. Quantum computational networks. Proc. Roy. Soc. Lond A, 425, 1989] and the one-way model [R. Raussendorf and H. J. Briegel. A one-way quantum computer. Physical Review Letters, 86, 2001] to overcome challenging issues in building large-scale quantum computers. Instead of directly manipulating each qubit to perform universal quantum log
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract introduces Ancilla-Driven Quantum Computation and twisted graph states for universal quantum computation, with no discussion of entanglement witnesses, Lie algebra rank, or quantum query complexity bounds. It shares only the broad quantum computing framework but does not interact with the specific conjecture.
